status: POST-FIELD, POST-AUDIT, LOCKED RETROSPECTIVE SEQUENTIAL REPLAY

scientific_classification.guardrail: Results may not be used to claim prospective experimental superiority of Active over Space.

purpose: Re-run the frozen Active-vs-Space acquisition logic sequentially on the three already-acquired physical maps, with a fully declared physical-scale adaptation and no post-run tuning.

data.preprocessing: none: no smoothing, interpolation, outlier exclusion, or imputation

common_seed.rationale: Historical numerical six-point seed is scaled isotropically by physical-side/numerical-side = 4/60 = 1/15 about the injection origin, then snapped to the nearest 0.25-m physical candidate; stable candidate order breaks ties.

seed_mode.starts: normalized mapping of the frozen 16 numerical seed starts to the physical L,d bounds

checkpoint_mode.starts: previous estimate plus six normalized frozen perturbations

optimizer.objective_scale: sigma_design = 1% RMS of the six revealed seed measurements; held fixed for the case. No unselected field value is used to define it.
optimizer.voronoi_weighting: discrete Voronoi weights over all 289 candidate locations

acquisition.Active: same Voronoi-consistent A-optimal criterion as frozen numerical core; covariance transformed to endpoint-x, endpoint-y, depth; stable-order tie breaking
acquisition.Space: deterministic geometric maximin; stable-order tie breaking
acquisition.candidate_revelation: Only selected/revealed Z_field values are supplied to the estimator. Unselected measured values are not used for fitting or Active candidate selection.

evaluation.primary: paired continuous N=15 errors: endpoint, depth, orientation, and length
evaluation.secondary: historical relative-depth <=10% indicator, reported only for continuity with the earlier audit
evaluation.full_map_RMSE: evaluation-only after selection; never used for acquisition

stop_discipline: Run all three depths and both methods before interpreting outcomes.
Do not change seed, scale, bounds, M, weights, optimizer starts/limits, A-optimal rule, Space rule, checkpoints, or budget after any replay outcome is viewed.
Any behavior-preserving runtime fix must be documented and the protocol version incremented; scientific choices may not be changed.
